title: Implementation of Convolutional Neural Network for Android-Based Classification of Taekwondo Martial Arts
desc: Authored an international conference paper on integrating a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) deep-learning model into an Android application for real-time martial arts pose classification. The study compares the effect of the number of convolution layers, hidden layers, and dropout layers on test accuracy, with the best scenario reaching 61.28% accuracy, and integrates the model into a mobile app using TensorFlow Lite.
